fields.name: enabled
fields.description: Enables proofing. A provider is also required before SuperDoc runs checks.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Checks the text segments SuperDoc supplies and returns spelling, grammar, or style issues.

fields.name: defaultLanguage
fields.description: Fallback language passed to the provider when a text segment has no resolved language.

fields.name: debounceMs
fields.description: Delay in milliseconds between an edit and the next proofing check. Values at or below 0 run without a delay.

fields.name: maxSuggestions
fields.description: Suggestion limit passed to the provider. The provider decides how to apply it.

fields.name: allowIgnoreWord
fields.description: Shows Ignore in the proofing context menu. Ignored words remain suppressed for this editor session.

fields.name: ignoredWords
fields.description: Words whose proofing issues SuperDoc suppresses. Matching is case-insensitive after Unicode normalization.

fields.name: timeoutMs
fields.description: Maximum provider call time in milliseconds. Non-positive or non-finite values use the default.

fields.name: onProofingError
fields.description: Runs when a provider check fails or times out.

fields.name: onStatusChange
fields.description: Runs when the proofing lifecycle status changes.
